messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] 5xx surge detected on /v1/chat/stream (us-west-2). error-rate 15% -> 36% over 4m. paging #incidents-oncall.
Ravi: Oncall Ravi here, taking lead. @Ana L can you join?
Ana L: joining, looking at logs. first glance shows segfaults in model-runtime-v2 on several hosts.
Kai M: I see repeated "free(): double free" in kv_cache.c and earlier OOM warnings. stacks attached.
Ravi: impact assessment: user requests are failing with 50x errors for a subset of hosted customers in us-west-2, latency bumped for others. Olga please loop in support.
Olga D: notified CS/Support. alerting top 5 customers in region and creating tickets: TKT-998, TKT-999.
Kai M: cores landed at s3://redwood-incidents/3291234567/cores/ (node infer-w05). quick gdb bt:
```
#0 0x7f2d4c1a in free () from /lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libc.so.6
#1 0x564b1e2 in kv_cache_free (cache=0x7f1a2b0) at kv_cache.c:389
#2 0x564b3f0 in model_step
#3 0x564b8aa in request_handler
```
Ana L: pattern: memory pressure -> eviction -> concurrent free -> segfault. likely race in eviction path when async writeback overlaps.
Ravi: immediate mitigations? can we reduce memory pressure by routing traffic to a compatible smaller/quantized model variant?
Kai M: yes, model-3b-q4 is API-compatible and halves memory. propose emergency routing of new connections to it, keep tiny canary to monitor.
Ravi: do it for hosted customers in us-west-2 only. create routing entry and keep 2% baseline on old runtime for monitoring.
Kai M: running command:
```
redwood routing update --region us-west-2 --match "/v1/chat/stream" \
  --from model-runtime-v2 --to model-3b-q4 --weight 98 --canary 2
```
incident-bot: routing change applied: route-id rc-32912. new sessions will prefer model-3b-q4.
Kai M: cordoning and draining affected nodes (infer-w05, infer-w07):
```
kubectl cordon infer-w05
kubectl drain infer-w05 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data
```
Olga D: CS reports 3 customers with intermittent 5xx (tickets updated). Offering credits and workaround: limit concurrency or switch to fallback model.
Ravi: good. telemetry shows 5xx drop from 36% -> 7% within 4m after routing change. partial mitigation confirmed.
Kai M: pushing hotfix branch hotfix/kv-evict-race: added atomic refcount and null-check before free, plus backpressure on eviction. CI job ci-99421 started.
incident-bot: CI ci-99421 succeeded. artifact at s3://redwood-artifacts/hotfix-kv-evict/ci-99421.tar.gz
Ana L: deploying to a 1-node canary (infer-canary-01) in us-west-2. running smoke: 2000 reqs, no segfaults, memory stable.
Ravi: expand to 4-node canary with gradual rollout and 5m evaluation windows, auto-rollback if 5xx increases by >1%.
Kai M: expanded. monitoring shows stable canary. preparing region roll with 3m bubble between batches.
Olga D: Support notes: customers TKT-998 and TKT-999 saw errors for ~14 minutes during spike; TKT-1000 unaffected. updating customers to say mitigation in place and hotfix deploy underway.
Ravi: plan summary: 1) keep routing fallback to model-3b-q4 2) full hotfix rollout across us-west-2 pools with safety gates 3) once stable for 60m, revert routing if performance ok or keep fallback if degradation observed.
Kai M: rolling to the rest of the region. automated rollback rule in place.
incident-bot: metrics: 5xx now at 3.8%, latency returned ~baseline values. Incident status: MITIGATED.
Ravi: handing off overnight watch to Ana. I'm available for follow-up; leaving notes in incident tracker.
Ana L: taking overnight ownership. will monitor dashboards and ensure postmortem draft is started.
Olga D: CS will send final customer follow-up after final rollout.
Kai M: saved traces, heap snapshots, and test artifacts to s3://redwood-incidents/3291234567/artifacts/. opening high-priority bug and linking tickets.
Ravi: postmortem owners: Kai M (technical), Ana L (ops), Olga D (customer comms), Ravi (incident review). scheduling postmortem meeting for 2026-03-05 16:00 UTC.
incident-bot: Follow-ups: postmortem within 48h, action items: add eviction backpressure, per-tenant QoS throttles, better preflight for large prefix loads.
Ana L: closing the page for now. leave channel open for any regressions. :white_check_mark:
